tickets.description: RF channel interference with adjacent APs. Adjusted 5GHz channel width to 80MHz and calibrated transmit power.

tickets.title: Panasonic EPABX Digital Intercom Extension 204 Dead
tickets.description: No dial tone on digital proprietary key phone KX-T7730 in dispatch room.
tickets.resolutionNotes: Crimped corroded RJ11 connector in junction distribution box. Line voltage verified 48V DC idle.

tickets.equipmentModel: Dell EMC PowerEdge R740 2U Rack Server (2x Xeon Gold)
tickets.description: iDRAC9 logged redundant cooling fan module failure. Ambient temp 24C.
tickets.resolutionNotes: Replaced hot-plug redundant fan assembly P/N 023KNT. Verified thermal equilibrium in OpenManage Enterprise.
